note: 기분일기 2층에 하루 1장. 넘기기 가능. 존댓말, 판단·평가·조언 없음. 답을 강요하지 않는 열린 질문만.

cards.text_ko: 오늘 가장 힘들었던 순간은 언제였어요?
cards.text_en: When was the hardest moment of your day?

cards.text_ko: 몸이 먼저 알아챈 신호가 있었나요?
cards.text_en: Did your body notice something before you did?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 나를 조금 편하게 해준 건 뭐였어요?
cards.text_en: What made things a little easier for you today?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 처음으로 숨을 크게 쉰 순간이 있었나요?
cards.text_en: Was there a moment today when you finally took a deep breath?

cards.text_ko: 지금 이 시간의 기분을 한 단어로 부른다면요?
cards.text_en: If you had to name how you feel right now in one word, what would it be?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 하루 중 가장 조용했던 시간은 언제였어요?
cards.text_en: What was the quietest part of your day today?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 만난 사람 중에 마음에 남는 사람이 있나요?
cards.text_en: Was there someone you saw today who stayed on your mind?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 하기로 했던 것 중에 미룬 게 있다면, 무엇이었어요?
cards.text_en: If there was something you meant to do today but put off, what was it?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 몸이 가장 무거웠던 시간대는 언제였어요?
cards.text_en: When did your body feel heaviest today?

cards.text_ko: 어젯밤 잠은 어땠어요? 기억나는 만큼만요.
cards.text_en: How was your sleep last night? Just as much as you remember.

cards.text_ko: 오늘 한 끼라도 편하게 먹었나요?
cards.text_en: Did you get to eat at least one meal comfortably today?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 마음이 가장 흔들린 순간은 무엇 때문이었을까요?
cards.text_en: What do you think caused the moment your feelings shook the most today?

cards.text_ko: 지금 몸에서 가장 신경 쓰이는 곳은 어디예요?
cards.text_en: Right now, what part of your body is bothering you the most?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 스스로에게 해주고 싶은 말이 있다면요?
cards.text_en: Is there something you'd like to say to yourself today?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 하루를 색으로 칠한다면 어떤 색일까요?
cards.text_en: If you painted today in one color, what would it be?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 창밖이나 하늘을 본 적이 있나요?
cards.text_en: Did you get a chance to look out the window or up at the sky today?

cards.text_ko: 요즘 반복해서 떠오르는 생각이 있나요?
cards.text_en: Is there a thought that keeps coming back to you these days?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 잠깐이라도 마음이 놓였던 장소가 있었어요?
cards.text_en: Was there a place today where you felt at ease, even briefly?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 약을 챙기는 건 어땠어요? 부담이 되진 않았나요?
cards.text_en: How did taking your medication go today — was it a burden?

cards.text_ko: 요즘 몸에 생긴 변화 중에 말하지 못한 게 있나요?
cards.text_en: Is there a change in your body lately that you haven't been able to talk about?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 하루, 나에게 가장 필요했던 건 무엇이었을까요?
cards.text_en: What do you think you needed most today?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 아무에게도 말하지 않은 이야기가 있나요?
cards.text_en: Is there something today you haven't told anyone?

cards.text_ko: 다음 진료 때 꼭 말하고 싶은 게 떠올랐나요?
cards.text_en: Did anything come to mind that you want to be sure to mention at your next appointment?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 들었던 소리나 노래 중에 남아 있는 게 있어요?
cards.text_en: Is there a sound or song from today that's still with you?

cards.text_ko: 일주일 전의 나와 지금의 나는 어디가 다를까요?
cards.text_en: How are you different now from a week ago?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 하루 중 다시 돌아가고 싶은 순간이 있나요?
cards.text_en: Is there a moment today you'd want to go back to?

cards.text_ko: 오늘 미룬 일 말고, 해낸 아주 작은 일 하나는 뭐였어요?
cards.text_en: Setting aside what you put off, what's one small thing you did manage today?

cards.text_ko: 지금 몸의 긴장을 0에서 10으로 말한다면 몇쯤일까요?
cards.text_en: If you rated the tension in your body right now from 0 to 10, where would it land?

cards.text_ko: 내일의 나에게 미리 남겨두고 싶은 말이 있나요?
cards.text_en: Is there something you'd like to leave for tomorrow's you?

cards.text_ko: 오늘은 그냥 여기까지여도 괜찮아요. 남기고 싶은 한 줄이 있나요?
cards.text_en: It's okay if today just ends here. Is there one line you'd like to leave?
